historical_claims.anchor: A woman called Rahel comes back to Ayemenem, in Kerala, in 1993.
The twins are thirty-one years old, and they have spent much of their lives apart.
Velutha works at the pickle factory and is skilled with machines and wood.
At the cinema they go to see The Sound of Music.

historical_claims.anchor: Velutha dies from the violence inflicted on him.
The book brings them to an incestuous sexual encounter.

description: Connects the twins’ fragmented memories to caste, family power, forbidden intimacy, political violence, and the words that shape remembered experience. Covers A house to which someone returns; The Ipe family before the visit; Velutha and the children; Rahel and Estha again.
